description: This source file contains the implementation of the HomeSectionsAdapter class for an Android application, which manages the rendering of various types of sections on the home screen, including headers, banners, and content rows. It includes nested ViewHolder classes, DiffUtil callback, and associated data models to support a vertically scrolling list of sections with horizontal carousels and focus management.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter managing different section types (header, banner, content row) in a RecyclerView for the home screen, including ViewHolder subclasses and diffs.

classes.name: HeaderSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the header section, managing brand title and top navigation bar with focus behavior.

classes.name: BannerSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the banner section, implementing horizontal paging with snap helper and dynamic size adjustments.

classes.name: ContentRowSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for content rows with horizontal lists of cards, handling focus and scroll adjustments.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder, updating UI components and focus handling.
